{
  "$schema": "https://openai.com/mcp/manifest/schema-v1.json",
  "name": "Agentic Workflow v10.7",
  "description": "MCP-compliant orchestration of multi-agent LLM stacks.",
  "version": "10.7.1",
  "tools": [
    { "id": "redis", "path": "redis", "type": "cache" },
    { "id": "chromadb", "path": "chromadb", "type": "vectorstore" },
    { "id": "openai", "path": "openai", "type": "llm" }
  ],
  "schemas": [
    "master_config_v10_7.json",
    "job_input.json"
  ],
  "agents": [
    "SafetyGuardStack",
    "StrategyStack",
    "RAGStack",
    "DraftingStack",
    "QAStack",
    "HILStack",
    "MetaLearningLoop"
  ],
  "telemetry": { "endpoint": "/metrics", "mode": "emit" },
  "governance": { "validator": "core_v10_7.validate_schema" }
}
